newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-FOUR WALKER CUP WINNERS NAMED IN 1997 SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-FOUR WALKER CUP WINNERS NAMED IN 1997 SQUAD.

text.p: Britain and Ireland have shown their determination to retain the Walker Cup amateur team golf title in New York next August by naming a 21-man training squad for the defence.

The squad for the match at Quaker Ridge on August 9 and 10 includes four of the side who won 14-10 at Porthcawl, Wales, last year - Scots Barclay Howard and Graham Rankin, England's Gary Wolstenholme and Irishman Jody Fanagan.
There are seven Englishmen, six Scots, five Irishmen and three Welshman in the squad.
The team will be picked after the European team championship at Portmarnock on June 25-29, giving time for players from outside the squad to force their way into the reckoning.
The squad is likely to go to southern Spain in the spring and former Ryder Cup captain Bernard Gallacher will again be asked to assist with coaching, as he did before the Porthcawl match.
